## History

Baxter is a local resident who converted from Presbyterianism to Methodism after hearing the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) choir sing a specific song when walking up the aisle with his wife, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), following their marriage. His new affiliation led to his involvement with the [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) church, where a prayer meeting was held near the cemetery where local children were overheard singing.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P18](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI.
